annotations.title: Start an order-to-cash run on your business

description: Run a day of your own business through the four order-to-cash agents: read new orders, check stock and credit, pick lists, invoices and their emails, match bank lines to open invoices, chase late payers and handle return emails. Nothing is sent; you get drafts and decisions. The agents ask the founder about credit, short stock, packing, reminders, unclear payments and returns, unless the business's approval rules say otherwise. Priced per order from the account's credits: $1.00 an order (100 credits), model cost included, charged once when an order is invoiced, collected or has a return settled. Data is deleted 2 days after the last change. Needs a signed-in Requstory account. Then call advance_o2c_run.

business.description: The business, like the run page's folder. Keys: company, symbol ("£"), vat ("20%"), termsDays, nextInvoiceNo; customers [{id, name, email, creditLimit, openBalance, termsDays}]; products [{sku, name, price, stock}]; orders [{name, text} or {name, imageBase64} for a JPEG/PNG scan]; openInvoices [{no, customer, total, paid, due, date}]; bank [{from, ref, amount}]; returns [{message}]; returnsPolicy (text); instructions {orders, finance, returns} (text for each agent); approvals {ordersOver, overCreditLimitUpTo, refundsUpTo, returnsWithinDays, shortPaymentWriteOffUpTo}: orders above ordersOver always go to the founder; up to overCreditLimitUpTo over a credit limit, and refunds or credit notes up to refundsUpTo that the calculator agrees with, go through without asking; returns for invoices older than returnsWithinDays (or with no invoice date) always go to the founder; a matched payment that leaves shortPaymentWriteOffUpTo or less owed closes the invoice. Leave approvals out (or 0) to be asked about everything. The resource requstory://o2c/guide explains them.

mapId.description: Map whose credits pay for the model calls. Default: your most recent map.

model.description: Open model the agents use. Default: the best scorer in the weekly test.
